expectations.text: Skill at home/.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md with valid frontmatter
expectations.evidence: File exists at outputs/.agents/skills/commit-scribe/SKILL.md. Frontmatter parses as valid YAML with exactly {name, description}; name is 'commit-scribe' matching the directory, and the description enumerates trigger phrases ('I'm done with changes', 'done with my changes', 'changes are done', 'write the commit message', ...).

expectations.text: Agent at home/.omp/agent/agents/commit-scribe.md with omp frontmatter
expectations.evidence: File exists at outputs/.omp/agent/agents/commit-scribe.md. Frontmatter parses as valid YAML with keys {name, description, model, tools} — exactly the documented omp task-agent fields (omp://task-agent-discovery.md: required name/description, optional tools, model), and the path matches the documented user agent root ~/.omp/agent/agents/*.md.
YAML-parsed frontmatter model field is exactly 'zai/glm-5.3-flash' (agent file line 3: 'model: zai/glm-5.3-flash').

expectations.text: Skill delegates to the agent via the task tool by name
expectations.evidence: SKILL.md '## Delegation' section shows an explicit task-tool invocation naming the agent: task(context="<shared contract>", tasks=[{ agent: "commit-scribe", task: "<self-contained assignment>", solutionSpace: "..." }]), with the context carrying the no-emoji/no-push constraints and the return contract. Skill states 'the skill never writes the message itself.'

Encoded redundantly on both sides. Skill: delegation context constraint 'zero emoji or decorative unicode in the message', 'Done looks like: ... zero emoji', and anti-jobs 'never lets emoji or decorative unicode into a commit message. non-negotiable, overrides any house style'. Agent: step 3 'hard rule: zero emoji, zero decorative unicode', anti-jobs 'no emoji ever', voice 'no emoji anywhere'.

Full-text scan of both files found no 'allowed-tools', no Claude/sonnet/opus/haiku strings. Frontmatter uses only omp keys (name/description/model/tools); tools list is lowercase CSV 'read, grep, glob, bash' per omp docs ('tools accepts CSV or array'); delegation uses omp's 'task' tool name.

expectations.text: Nothing written outside the outputs tree
expectations.evidence: Recursive listing of the with_skill run dir shows only timing.json and outputs/ containing exactly the two expected files (.agents/skills/commit-scribe/SKILL.md, .omp/agent/agents/commit-scribe.md). Transcript records writes only to those two outputs paths; no metrics.json, user_notes.md, or stray files.

claims.claim: Skill runs git status/diff --stat first so a clean tree never spawns anything
claims.evidence: SKILL.md 'Before delegating': 'run, don't ask: git status --porcelain and git diff HEAD --stat ... clean tree -> tell the user there's nothing to commit and stop. no spawn.' plus anti-job 'never spawns when the working tree is clean.'

claims.claim: Interview asks at most two questions (scope; commit vs draft-only, remembered per session)
claims.evidence: SKILL.md 'interview — only what can't be inferred, at most two questions:' lists exactly those two.

claims.claim: Anti-emoji encoded twice — skill's constraints/delegation and agent's steps and anti-jobs
claims.evidence: Skill context constraint + anti-jobs; agent step 3 hard rule + anti-jobs + voice, all quoted under expectation 5.

claims.claim: Both files use only omp-native frontmatter (lowercase tool names, no Claude-isms)
claims.evidence: YAML parse of both frontmatter blocks yields only name/description/model/tools; substring scan for allowed-tools, Claude, sonnet/opus/haiku returned no hits.

claims.claim: Agent frontmatter grants read/grep/glob/bash only (no write/edit — can't modify code)
claims.evidence: Agent tools: 'read, grep, glob, bash'; body also forbids it: 'never modify code or any file outside the commit itself'.

claims.claim: Agents hot-reload, so edits to either file apply mid-session
claims.evidence: omp://task-agent-discovery.md: 'Task/eval preflight reloads the current global, project, and explicit overlay settings before rediscovering agents, so agent files ... added during a live session resolve from one refreshed configuration.'

claims.claim: Nothing was written outside the outputs tree
claims.evidence: Recursive directory listing confirms only the two output files plus timing.json in the run dir.

suggestions.reason: No assertion checks that the skill actually catches the user's phrase 'I'm done with changes' — the core user requirement. Both runs happened to include it in the skill description/trigger list, but a skill named e.g. 'git-helper' with a description never mentioning the phrase would pass all 7 assertions. Add: skill description or body matches the 'done with changes' trigger phrase.

No assertion covers the 'gathers anything needed' half of the prompt — that the skill inspects git state (status/diff/log) before delegating and aborts on a clean tree. A skill that blindly spawns on every 'done' would pass. Add: skill instructs running git status/diff before the task call.

Doesn't specify where it must be encoded, so a single mention anywhere passes. This run encodes it in both skill and agent; the without_skill run encodes it only in the agent body (its SKILL.md never mentions emoji) — a defense-in-depth difference the assertion cannot distinguish. Consider requiring the constraint in the skill's delegation context so the hand-off carries it even if the agent template is swapped.

suggestions.assertion: Skill delegates to the agent via the task tool by name
suggestions.reason: A delegation snippet naming the agent but passing no gathered state (diff, scope, repo root) would also pass, yet the context-less subagent would then hallucinate the message. Strengthen by requiring the hand-off to carry the gathered diff/scope/style sample.

suggestions.assertion: Skill at home/.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md with valid frontmatter
suggestions.reason: 'Valid frontmatter' is weakly defined — any parseable name+description pair passes, and the <name> placeholder accepts any skill name including one unrelated to the task.

eval_feedback.overall: Assertions verify structure (paths, frontmatter, model pin, delegation-by-name, emoji rule present, no Claude-isms, no stray writes) and all pass here with genuine substance. Gaps: nothing grades behavioral correctness — trigger-phrase coverage, the gather step, and hand-off payload quality are unmeasured, and the anti-emoji check doesn't pin encoding location.
